policy.rule: A passed gate must contain at least one real evidence item and no non-production evidence item. Mock, fake-model, Tier-1 deterministic orchestration, and simulation artifacts may validate contracts/orchestration only. They may not promote provider correctness, live MCP interoperability, real hardware, real network, soak, or release claims.
policy.release_rule: Production-v1 release readiness is the conjunction of the status ledger and protected branch/release gates. Fail closed on missing required evidence.

evidence.assertion: PR #72 exact head passed real TLS Streamable-HTTP MCP interoperability using the official MCP Go SDK through the canonical backend ToolRegistry path; quality/security/e2e workflows passed on the same head.

mcp_external_integration.reason: The external MCP backend path is implemented and has exact-head real TLS Streamable-HTTP interoperability evidence. Firmware still does not run MCP directly; physical/device capability evidence remains separate.

evidence.assertion: PR #66 exact head passed adversarial identity isolation: forged X-Device-* headers cannot override the authenticated per-device credential context, and wrong/revoked credential lifecycle checks fail closed.

security_default_deny.reason: The enrolled per-device authentication boundary and default-deny identity isolation are merged and have exact-head adversarial software evidence. Deployment TLS/origin policy is enforced separately by the product transport/origin guard.

evidence.assertion: Explicit consent/revocation and memory privacy boundaries are exercised in the merged product path; historical retention/delete proof predates the PostgreSQL hard cut.

privacy_explicit_consent.reason: Privacy implementation is merged and consent-gated behavior is exercised, but the evidence registry does not yet contain a canonical PostgreSQL-backed real retention/delete proof after the SQLite hard cut. Keep this gate partial rather than inheriting obsolete storage evidence.
